description: Agent Hiring: submit an engagement contract with the accepted quote and the brief: the contract with the client, the contractor, the currency, the price, the unit, the quote it cites, each item of work it includes, the days signed, starting and ending, and the payment schedule (upfront, on completion, milestones, weekly, biweekly or monthly) and payment due days; optionally the accepted quote with its reference, candidate, currency, price, unit, scope and payment terms; and optionally the brief with the client, its work and the days it sets. The signed report gives the contract, the quote and the brief, the price and the unit against the quote, the quoted scope matched to the contract scope with the items dropped and added, the contractor and the client against the quote and the brief, the start and completion against the brief, and the payment terms against the quote, and counts them, and names a divergent contract: a price, unit or payment schedule unlike the accepted quote, an item of the quote dropped or a contract item the quote does not cover, another contractor or client, a completion after the brief’s due day and a completion before the start; then another cited quote, other payment due days, another start day, brief work the contract leaves out and a signing after work starts, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No accepted quote, no brief, no price, no scope on either side, no completion day or no payment schedule leaves the contract unverified. Parties match without a legal suffix and amounts to the cent. An engagement contract here is read against the accepted quote and the brief: wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one contract text clause by clause, wever_contract-brief summarizes one contract excerpt’s parties, term, renewal and payment terms, and wever_energy-contract-check and wever_build-contract-check read energy supply and construction contracts for Agent Energy and Agent Construction, while the contract check reads the price, scope, schedule, parties and payment terms against the quote and the brief. Verdict hire_contract_divergent, hire_contract_partial, hire_contract_unverified or hire_contract_consistent. POST /api/hire-contract-check. Reads the hiring paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no judgment of whether a candidate is good, qualified in substance or worth hiring, no background check, no contact with referees or issuers, no verification with outside sources and no employment-law advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Hiring reads supplied hiring paperwork for consistency between documents: a hiring brief, a credential record, a portfolio or past-work record, a reference, a rate quote, an engagement contract, an availability commitment and a payment setup. Beside it, wever_post-job, wever_accept-job and the other tools of the intent job kit are the execution layer that posts, accepts and settles jobs, and wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork before anything is committed; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-hiring-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-hiring/.
